name: Foundry Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Industrial sound-sculptor tunes for Foundry: bass, leads, stabs, pads, metal percussion, drones, textures and sound effects in Industrial, Techno, Dark Ambient, Cinematic, Sound Design, Horror, Experimental, Noise, Drone, Metal Percussion and Electro styles. Foundry is monophonic: play single notes from a keyboard or sequencer (drone tunes sound while the transport runs or the drone button is on).
